decisions.label: Indoor camera angle
decisions.note: Landed on the treehouse's floor the camera eases to this angle, degrees below the horizon (camera.house.angle; Ed, 2026-10-14: "the camera zooms in so you can see the detail").

decisions.label: Indoor camera distance
decisions.note: Indoors the camera's distance is the ordinary one times this (camera.house.distance): smaller is closer.

decisions.label: Indoor camera ease
decisions.note: Seconds the camera takes to push in as she lands on the balcony, and back out as she flies off (camera.house.ease).

decisions.label: Landing on the balcony
decisions.note: Seconds she takes to come down onto the balcony when she flies onto it at treetop height (treehouse.house.landTime).

decisions.label: Rising from the circle
decisions.note: After a knockout, seconds she takes to rise out of the magic circle's floor before walking to her decks (knockout.rise).

decisions.label: Fall off the balcony
decisions.note: With this on she has no broom: off the balcony's open rim she falls and comes back at the circle (treehouse.house.fall.on). Off, she flies again. A switch until the brooms are objects (step 3).
